{{Top|leg}}
'''Dankayo Base''' was an administrative base for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the base served three [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] for purposes of coordination and records. At some point between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battles of Yavin]] and [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] discovered the location of the base and ordered the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']], [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], and [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] to destroy it. The Alliance learned of the impending assault,<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']].</ref> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] ordered the evacuation of the base.<ref name="General Carlist Rieekan in the Databank">{{DB|character|generalcarlistrieekan|Rieekan, General Carlist}}</ref> Only one operative, [[Agent ZNT-8]], was left behind as an observer in the temporary safety of a deep-planet survival shelter.<ref name="SH" />
